column1: 2020: CBT payroll of $239,823,270. $208M threshold, 30 percent rate as second-time payor, surtax for amount over $228M. MLB suspended tax for 2020
2019: $6,742,435 tax on CBT payroll of $234,570,109 with $206M threshold and 20 percent rate as a first-time payor.
2018: The Yankees CBT payroll of $192,980,833 did not exceed the $197M threshold for MLB's competitive balance tax.
2017: $15,719,318 tax on CBT payroll of $224,224,707 with $195M threshold and 50 percent rate, plus surtax, as a 15-time payor.
2016: $27,396,653 tax on CBT payroll of $243,793,306 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 14-time payor.
2015: $26,108,784 tax on CBT payroll of $241,217,569 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as 13-time payor.
2014: $18,326,948 tax on CBT payroll of $225,653,896 wirh $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 12-time payor.
* Option figures are estimates, with 2020 not counted as an option year except in cases an arbitrator ruled otherwise.
* Unofficial payroll for purposes of the Competitive Balance Tax under Article XXIII of MLB collective bargaining agreement. Estimated figures in italics.
* Figures include the average annual values of contracts for players on the 40-man roster, plus about $15M per club for health and pension benefits.
* Tax Thresholds: Tax is assessed on amount above $195M in 2017, $197M in 2018, $206M in 2019, $208M in 2020, and $210M in 2021.
* Tax Rate: 20% for first-time payors, 30% for second-time payors, 50% for payors for 3 or more times. Rate resets if payroll falls below tax threshold for a season.
* 42.5% surtax for first time exceeding threshold by more than $40M. 45% surtax for exceeding threshold by more than $40M the following season(s).
* Club exceeding threshold by $40M has its first selection in the next Rule 4 draft moved back 10 places. Club picking in top 6 has its second pick moved back.
